title: SHAKTI: Securing Hardware IPs by Cascade Gated Multiplexer-Based Logic Obfuscation
problem: Logic locking vulnerable to SAT/structural learning attacks; MUX-based locking susceptible despite effectiveness
motivation: Distributed chip design chain faces IP piracy/overproduction; logic locking essential; need attack-resilient locking
method: SHAKTI/SHAKTI+: cascade gated MUX-based locking with daisy-chained structure; 64-128 bit keys
key_novelty: Cascade gated MUX locking resistant to SAT/SCOPE attacks with 19.32-19.45% area overhead
contributions: SAT attack timeout on all netlists
